details: Iran has signaled a shift to a "fully offensive" military posture as diplomatic efforts to secure a permanent peace deal with the United States have stalled. Washington has reportedly refused to extend a temporary ceasefire. This escalation threatens to reignite conflict and disrupt oil tanker traffic in the strategic Strait of Hormuz. The ongoing tensions contribute to market uncertainty, driving up oil prices and increasing economic hardships for Iran. Such geopolitical instability often leads to increased volatility in cryptocurrency markets.
title: Iran Threatens Offensive as US Rules Out Ceasefire Extension
